records.text: The Cattle Baron's Ball in Dallas is a single-night fundraiser for the American Cancer Society, is the world's largest single-night fundraiser, and was founded 50 years ago.

verification.notes: The Dallas Cattle Baron's Ball's official site confirms it began in 1974, benefits the American Cancer Society, and describes itself as the world's largest single-night fundraiser for the society. appearances.snippet: We know that for a fact because one of his high school buddies after the assassination posted this. Bro, the head of Charlie Kirk's security team, the guy they say is in on it was my friend as a kid. We grew up together. I went to middle and high school with Dan Flood. Matter of fact, last time I saw him. He was doing security for some Dallas billionaire at the Cattleman's Ball. What a crazy small world. verification.notes: The transcript quotes an unidentified social-media post, but the original post, author identity, and relationship to Dan Flood are not available for authentication. Live searches found no reliable independent source confirming all three details: shared middle/high school, 20 years in private security, and the Cattlemen's Ball encounter.
